content.text: /ext:medcp What are the most frequent health events by category happening within 12 months after ALS diagnosis, and how do they impact the need for mechanical ventilation?
I’ll query the OMOP data to define the ALS cohort, identify post-diagnosis event categories, and compare subsequent mechanical ventilation rates.

I’ll use broad, clinically interpretable categories from condition/procedure/device/observation records in the first 365 days after first ALS diagnosis, then estimate ventilation association as risk ratio vs ALS patients without that category.

arguments.sql_query:
WITH als_concepts AS (
  SELECT descendant_concept_id AS concept_id FROM omop.concept_ancestor WHERE ancestor_concept_id = 373182
  UNION SELECT 373182
),
als AS (
  SELECT person_id, MIN(condition_start_date) AS als_date
  FROM omop.condition_occurrence
  WHERE condition_concept_id IN (SELECT concept_id FROM als_concepts)
  GROUP BY person_id
),
vent_base AS (
  SELECT concept_id FROM omop.concept WHERE concept_id IN (4230167,1448271,37158404,4332501,40461915,40378385,40312603,3524568,4177224,2007680,2008006,2008007,2008008,2008009,2788023,2788021,2788019,1781161,2788022,2788020,36802730,36802731,2788028,2788026,2788024,1781162,2788027,2788025,2788018,2788016,2787823,1781160,2788017,2787824,36802729,2788036,2788037,2788038,46273524,40481547,915608,915609,1128078,953197)
),
vent_concepts AS (
  SELECT concept_id FROM vent_base
  UNION SELECT ca.descendant_concept_id FROM omop.concept_ancestor ca JOIN vent_base vb ON ca.ancestor_concept_id = vb.concept_id
),
vent AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT a.person_id
  FROM als a JOIN omop.procedure_occurrence p ON p.person_id=a.person_id AND p.procedure_date BETWEEN a.als_date AND DATEADD(day,365,a.als_date) AND p.procedure_concept_id IN (SELECT concept_id FROM vent_concepts)
  UNION
  SELECT DISTINCT a.person_id
  FROM als a JOIN omop.device_exposure d ON d.person_id=a.person_id AND d.device_exposure_start_date BETWEEN a.als_date AND DATEADD(day,365,a.als_date) AND d.device_concept_id IN (SELECT concept_id FROM vent_concepts)
  UNION
  SELECT DISTINCT a.person_id
  FROM als a JOIN omop.condition_occurrence c ON c.person_id=a.person_id AND c.condition_start_date BETWEEN a.als_date AND DATEADD(day,365,a.als_date) AND c.condition_concept_id IN (SELECT concept_id FROM vent_concepts)
),
events_raw AS (
  SELECT a.person_id, c.condition_start_date AS event_date, co.concept_name, 'Condition' AS domain
  FROM als a JOIN omop.condition_occurrence c ON c.person_id=a.person_id AND c.condition_start_date BETWEEN a.als_date AND DATEADD(day,365,a.als_date)
  JOIN omop.concept co ON co.concept_id=c.condition_concept_id
  WHERE c.condition_concept_id NOT IN (SELECT concept_id FROM als_concepts) AND c.condition_concept_id NOT IN (SELECT concept_id FROM vent_concepts)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT a.person_id, p.procedure_date, co.concept_name, 'Procedure'
  FROM als a JOIN omop.procedure_occurrence p ON p.person_id=a.person_id AND p.procedure_date BETWEEN a.als_date AND DATEADD(day,365,a.als_date)
  JOIN omop.concept co ON co.concept_id=p.procedure_concept_id
  WHERE p.procedure_concept_id NOT IN (SELECT concept_id FROM vent_concepts)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT a.person_id, d.device_exposure_start_date, co.concept_name, 'Device'
  FROM als a JOIN omop.device_exposure d ON d.person_id=a.person_id AND d.device_exposure_start_date BETWEEN a.als_date AND DATEADD(day,365,a.als_date)
  JOIN omop.concept co ON co.concept_id=d.device_concept_id
  WHERE d.device_concept_id NOT IN (SELECT concept_id FROM vent_concepts)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT a.person_id, o.observation_date, co.concept_name, 'Observation'
  FROM als a JOIN omop.observation o ON o.person_id=a.person_id AND o.observation_date BETWEEN a.als_date AND DATEADD(day,365,a.als_date)
  JOIN omop.concept co ON co.concept_id=o.observation_concept_id
),
events AS (
  SELECT person_id,
    CASE
      WHEN LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%dysp%' OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%respirat%' OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%breath%' OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%pneumonia%' OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%hypox%' OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%cough%' OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%apnea%' OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%oxygen%' THEN 'Respiratory symptoms/complications'
      WHEN LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%dysphag%' OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%swallow%' OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%gastrostomy%' OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%feeding tube%' OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%malnutrition%' OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%weight loss%' OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%nutrition%' THEN 'Dysphagia/nutrition/feeding support'
      WHEN LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%weakness%' OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%paralysis%' OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%wheelchair%' OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%walker%' OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%gait%' OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%fall%' OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%mobility%' THEN 'Motor decline/mobility/falls'
      WHEN LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%speech%' OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%dysarth%' OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%communication%' OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%voice%' THEN 'Speech/communication impairment'
      WHEN LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%anxiety%' OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%depress%' OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%cognitive%' OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%dementia%' OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%insomnia%' THEN 'Neuropsychiatric/cognitive/sleep'
      WHEN LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%pain%' OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%cramp%' OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%spastic%' OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%spasm%' THEN 'Pain/spasticity/cramps'
      WHEN LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%infection%' OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%sepsis%' OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%urinary tract infection%' THEN 'Infections'
      ELSE 'Other recorded clinical events'
    END AS category
  FROM events_raw
),
cat_person AS (SELECT DISTINCT person_id, category FROM events),
cat_counts AS (
  SELECT category, COUNT(*) AS patients_with_event
  FROM cat_person GROUP BY category
),
stats AS (
  SELECT cc.category, cc.patients_with_event,
    SUM(CASE WHEN v.person_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ventilated_with_event,
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN v.person_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS float)/NULLIF(cc.patients_with_event,0) AS vent_rate_with_event,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM als) - cc.patients_with_event AS patients_without_event,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM vent) - SUM(CASE WHEN v.person_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ventilated_without_event
  FROM cat_counts cc
  JOIN cat_person cp ON cp.category=cc.category
  LEFT JOIN vent v ON v.person_id=cp.person_id
  GROUP BY cc.category, cc.patients_with_event
)
SELECT category,
  patients_with_event,
  ventilated_with_event,
  CAST(100.0*vent_rate_with_event AS decimal(8,2)) AS vent_pct_with_event,
  patients_without_event,
  ventilated_without_event,
  CAST(100.0*CAST(ventilated_without_event AS float)/NULLIF(patients_without_event,0) AS decimal(8,2)) AS vent_pct_without_event,
  CAST(vent_rate_with_event / NULLIF(CAST(ventilated_without_event AS float)/NULLIF(patients_without_event,0),0) AS decimal(8,2)) AS risk_ratio
FROM stats
ORDER BY patients_with_event DESC

ALS cohort: 3,626 patients, indexed at first ALS diagnosis. Mechanical ventilation within 12 months was found in 125 patients (3.4%). Categories are non-mutually exclusive.

| Post-ALS event category (≤12 mo) | Patients | Ventilated | Vent % with event | Vent % without event | Risk ratio |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Other recorded clinical events | 2,750 | 125 | 4.55% | 0.00% | NA |
| Dysphagia/nutrition/feeding support | 1,658 | 112 | 6.76% | 0.66% | 10.23 |
| Respiratory symptoms/complications | 1,496 | 124 | 8.29% | 0.05% | 176.55 |
| Motor decline/mobility/falls | 1,362 | 110 | 8.08% | 0.66% | 12.19 |
| Speech/communication impairment | 1,052 | 78 | 7.41% | 1.83% | 4.06 |
| Pain/spasticity/cramps | 898 | 74 | 8.24% | 1.87% | 4.41 |
| Neuropsychiatric/cognitive/sleep | 669 | 95 | 14.20% | 1.01% | 14.00 |
| Infections | 117 | 46 | 39.32% | 2.25% | 17.46 |

Key takeaways:
- The most frequent specific ALS-relevant categories were dysphagia/nutrition, respiratory complications, motor decline/falls, and speech impairment.
- Respiratory symptoms/complications were the strongest marker for ventilation: 124 of 125 ventilated patients had such an event recorded.
- Infections had the highest absolute ventilation rate (39.3%), but were less common.
- These are EHR associations, not causal estimates; timing was within the same 12-month window, not strictly event-before-ventilation.
